Subject: Vendor onboarding: Artera PO intake and payment terms

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding path. Attaching our vendor intake packet (Artera_POForm_v1.pdf) and W-9. We completed the basic fields but left the PO-specific header blank because your portal requires a Redwood PO number on submission.

A couple quick asks on terms so we can align with our treasury team: Artera normally bills Net60 by default for biotech contracts, but we can offer Net30 if Redwood evaluates early-pay (we typically offer a 1.75% early-pay discount to get paid within 10 business days). Would Redwood be open to a one-time early-pay pilot on the first invoice (Net10 at 1.75%) while we confirm ACH routing?

Contact for AP: payments@artera.io (cc'd).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—
Elena Soto
Head of Commercial Ops, Artera Labs
elena@artera.io | +1 415-555-0191

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Artera PO intake and payment terms

Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the clear ask. A few items before we can finalize: 

1) PO form: the "Tax ID / EIN" field is blank on Artera_POForm_v1.pdf — we need that to map to our PO header. Can you resend a file with the EIN populated?
2) Bank details: for early-pay evaluation we require bank account + a bank verification stub or voided check. Please do not put raw routing/account numbers in email; you can upload to our secure AP portal or send via the secure DocuSign payment attachment flow.
3) Redwood standard practice: newly onboarded suppliers default to Net45 for the first 90 days (to allow operational verification). We can consider a one-off early-pay pilot for the first invoice if Finance approves the discount and we capture bank verification. That pilot would be handled as an exception and needs sign-off from our finance lead (cc'd below).

I've looped in Monica (AP) and David (vendor ops) to help with mapping PO header fields and confirm what we need from your side for the PO to be created correctly. If you can return a filled PO form and a secure bank verification link, we'll triage for an early-pay pilot.

Quick next steps: 
- Elena: resend Artera_POForm_v1 with EIN populated and a secure bank verification upload (or mark to send via DocuSign).
- Monica: once we have the form + verification, please estimate turnaround to enable Net30 vs Net45 and escalate to Finance for discount approval.

Thanks,
—Markus
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference

For the pilot we propose: first invoice Net10 at 1.75% discount (applied as a separate line item on the invoice) or standard Net30 thereafter depending on how the initial settlement goes. If Redwood prefers a different cadence (e.g., Net15 with 1.25%), we can be flexible.

Let us know what documentation you need for the exception approval (SOW reference, invoice sample). Happy to provide a sample invoice and a DocuSign authorization for ACH.

Markus / Monica — reviewed Artera's request and the attached form. We can approve a one-time accelerated payment pilot for the first invoice under the following conditions: 

- Pilot: first invoice to be paid Net10 with a 1.75% early-pay fee (Artera's proposed).
- Finance requires: completed PO with EIN, bank verification upload to our portal (no account numbers via email), and a DocuSign authorization for the early-pay discount (we'll attach the discount schedule to the PO).
- Risk/credit: because Artera is Net60 by default historically, we will run a quick credit/ops check; if any red flags appear we reserve the right to default to Net45 for the first 2 invoices.

Monica — once Artera confirms the DocuSign link and upload, please create the PO with the following custom header fields: "Vendor-EIN", "EarlyPay-Flag", "AP-Contact", and include the agreed discount schedule under "PO Notes".

Elena — I'll generate a DocuSign envelope for the early-pay authorization and paste the link here. Please sign and return; once signed we will enable the pilot payment terms for the first invoice.
